name: new-beginnings-slates-v1
shared_prompt: anime film background art, washi paper and sumi ink meet modern digital painting, warm cream paper field with ink black linework, vermilion seal accents, thin veins of gold light along fold creases, cinematic composition, full bleed drawing that fills the entire image

defaults.negative: text, letters, words, watermark, logo, signature, caption, handwriting, photorealistic, photograph, 3d render, blurry, distorted, extra fingers, deformed hands, picture frame, frame, mat, border, torn paper, rips, creases crossing over faces, mask with eyes, wooden puppet, marionette

II.01.prompt: dawn through old glass, one paper crane on a wooden desk, amber lamp warmth over cream washi tones, vein of faint gold light travelling the fold edges, quiet and exact

items.name: the-crane-on-the-desk
items.prompt: a single small white paper crane sitting on a worn wooden intake desk in a quiet school room at dawn, amber lamp above, old glass window with soft grey rain beyond, a vein of faint golden light along the crane's crease edges, two steaming cups just out of focus

items.name: the-unfolded-sheet
items.prompt: an opened flat sheet of white paper lying on a wooden desk, fold impressions faintly visible as a map of a small building with doors and one filled small circle of light, drawing barely visible as crease marks not ink, morning light

items.name: the-lamp-still-on
items.prompt: close view of an old porch-style lamp glowing warm amber above a hatch, cream paper tones and deep ink shadow, moths absent, a folded paper crane resting on the hatch frame

II.02.prompt: an ordinary door being folded like paper, space bending gently, two rooms becoming one address, cream washi palette with ink lines, one gold seam of light, nobody crossing

items.name: the-flat-sheet-test
items.prompt: a simple wooden door in a quiet hallway being folded as if it were paper, the corridor bending around it into itself, warm cream and ink palette, a thin gold light travelling the new crease, calm not eerie

items.name: two-rooms-one-address
items.prompt: interior view of two different rooms shown as one folded page, one room's far wall meeting another room's near floor along a single crease, no doorway, soft warm light, ink and washi tones

II.03.prompt: a frightening mask unfolded flat into a harmless sheet of paper on a tea table, warm reconciliation, creek light, gentle humility

items.name: the-mask-unfolds
items.prompt: a white paper mask lying unfolded and flattened on a low tea table beside two cups, its frightening face now clearly only crease linework, daylight through a paper screen, a green creek visible through a window

items.name: the-creek-through-paper
items.prompt: a small clear creek seen through a window framed by paper, long grass on both banks, thin golden light along the window's crease lines, serene and safe

II.04.prompt: a large cream sheet with three colored creases — violet, rose, amber — crossing at one glowing singular point, diagram-like yet warm, three threads one intersection

items.name: the-crease-diagram-of-elias
items.prompt: a large flat sheet of cream paper with exactly three prominent crease lines, one cold violet, one soft rose, one warm amber, all crossing at a single point that glows faintly gold, minimal, precise, kind

items.name: three-threads-one-point
items.prompt: abstract macro view of three thin colored paper strips folding toward one shared crossing point on a cream field, violet and rose and amber, gold glow at the junction, no faces, no hands

II.05.prompt: the held breath — absence and glow, converging fold veins around a point the eye cannot sample, no instruments, warm void, the quietest image in the book

items.name: the-held-breath
items.prompt: a vast soft cream emptiness with faint gold crease veins converging toward the center from all edges, the exact center left blank and bright as unsampled light, one small held breath of morning mist, devastating quiet

items.name: the-singularity-walk
items.prompt: two small silhouettes walking toward each other along a single golden crease across a cream paper field, spaces folding flat around them, no doors, no instruments, warm and reverent

II.06.prompt: open evening at the school, a porch light folded into a paper lantern, gold veins lighting every crease in the room, celebration as quiet craft

items.name: the-paper-lantern
items.prompt: a warm amber paper lantern folded from a single sheet, glowing along every crease like veins of light, held aloft in a dark-warm room, small shadows of careful hands below

items.name: the-open-evening
items.prompt: a small warmly lit classroom in the evening, students' folded paper works on the tables, one large paper lantern as the only light, golden crease lights everywhere, welcome and calm

II.07.prompt: the first date — origami and flow, two figures looping between Tokyo and Haneda, motion as tenderness, cream washi and ink with a rose-and-amber seam of light

items.name: the-first-date-tokyo-haneda
items.prompt: two figures seen from behind on a late train running the Tokyo to Haneda loop, a young woman folding a small paper crane in her hands and a man beside her watching, the window a wash of soft rose and amber light-trails from the back-and-forth, city glow bleeding to airport blue, unhurried and warm

items.name: the-crane-between-two-hands
items.prompt: close view of a small paper crane being passed between two pairs of hands at an airport railing, night glass and distant runway lights soft behind, a thin gold vein of light along the crane's crease edges, tender and still
